title: Aviary AI crawler access log report
description: Local, bounded summaries of access-log requests whose user-agent strings contain recognized AI crawler tokens, including per-path recency, response-class details, same-path status comparisons by activity, and exact configured AI referral UTM source aggregates. A token match does not authenticate the requester; referral counts are request rows rather than sessions.

source.const: Aviary AI crawler access log analysis

sitemapFreshnessAnalyses.description: Optional sitemap lastmod versus retained crawler-log comparisons; observations are day-level and do not predict provider recrawl or citation.

responseStatusCode.description: Zero represents CloudFront sc-status 000, meaning no HTTP response status was available, or Cloudflare OriginResponseStatus 0, meaning the origin did not respond and the response was served at the edge; otherwise this is a three-digit HTTP status code.

source.const: Aviary AI crawler access log analysis

aiReferralTraffic.description: Exact configured utm_source request aggregates. Labels and normalized paths are retained; raw query values are omitted. Request counts are not sessions.

ipRangeVerification.description: Optional counts by configured crawler token. Neither source IP values nor configured CIDRs are included.

uniquePaths.description: Unique paths retained for this source; a true truncation flag makes this a lower bound.

originStatusObservations.description: Requests for which the input supplied both a logged response status and an origin response status.

edgeOriginStatusDifferences.description: Paired requests where the logged response status differs from the origin response status.

failureRequests.description: All logged requests for this crawler with a 4xx or 5xx response status.

failureRatePercent.description: The crawler's 4xx and 5xx request share within the supplied input sample.

pathsWithFailures.description: Distinct normalized paths with at least one logged 4xx or 5xx response, including paths outside the retained frequent-path list.

failureHotspots.description: Highest-priority paths with logged 4xx or 5xx responses, ranked by server-error count, failure count, failure share, then path.

originResponseStatusCodes.description: Bounded frequency list of origin response status codes when the log supplies them.

originResponseStatusCodesTruncated.description: True when additional origin status codes were omitted.

edgeOriginStatusDifferences.description: Requests on this path where the logged response status differs from the origin response status.

priorityReviewQueue.description: Bounded review prompts ranked by request share within each crawler token sample for matched paths with measured control, response, answer-structure, or citation-evidence signals.

priorityReviewQueueTruncated.description: True when queue rows were capped or source crawler paths or audited pages were omitted.

logCoverage.description: observed means every relevant retained token row is present for the path; observed-incomplete means at least one truncated token list omits it, so counts are lower bounds; not-observed-in-sample means all relevant lists were complete; incomplete means no retained row was found but a truncated list omitted the path.

originResponseStatusCodes.description: Bounded frequency list of origin response status codes when the log supplies them.

originResponseStatusCodesTruncated.description: True when additional origin status codes were omitted.

edgeOriginStatusDifferences.description: Requests on this path where the logged response status differs from the origin response status.

reviewSignals.description: Only measured current signals are emitted; these are review prompts, not claims that a feature is required or that it causes citations.

originResponseStatusCodes.description: Bounded frequency list of origin response status codes when the log supplies them.

originResponseStatusCodesTruncated.description: True when additional origin status codes were omitted.

edgeOriginStatusDifferences.description: Requests on this path where the logged response status differs from the origin response status.

failureSharePercent.description: The path's 4xx and 5xx requests divided by all logged requests for that path in the supplied sample.

cloudflareBotAnnotatedRequests.description: Requests on this path with at least one Cloudflare bot score, source, or verified-category field.

cloudflareVerifiedBotRequests.description: Requests on this path with either a Verified Bot BotScoreSrc value or a non-empty VerifiedBotCategory field.

cloudflareVerifiedBotFailureRequests.description: 4xx or 5xx responses among requests on this path with Cloudflare verified-bot evidence.

cloudflareSecurityActionRequests.description: Requests on this path with at least one recognized or unknown Cloudflare SecurityAction value.

cloudflareBlockingFailureRequests.description: 4xx or 5xx responses on this path where the logged Cloudflare action included block or connection close.

cloudflareChallengeFailureRequests.description: 4xx or 5xx responses on this path where the logged Cloudflare action included an active challenge.

cloudflareChallengeResolvedFailureReques.description: 4xx or 5xx responses on this path where the logged Cloudflare action included a solved or bypassed challenge.

requestsWithCloudflareBotFields.description: Recognized crawler requests with at least one Cloudflare bot score, score-source, or verified-bot-category field.

botScoreGroups.description: Cloudflare ranges: 0 not computed, 1 automated, 2–29 likely automated, and 30–99 likely human.

verifiedBotRequests.description: Requests with either a Verified Bot BotScoreSrc value or a non-empty VerifiedBotCategory field.

source.const: Aviary AI crawler log period comparison

oneOf.description: A decrease can exceed 100 percent when the sample grows substantially.

ipRangeVerification.description: Aggregate comparison of source-IP log fields against operator-supplied CIDRs. A match is range membership only, not crawler authentication.
